name: Brindlewick tax library (IRS publications, forms, instructions, IRM, the tax code)
domain: US federal tax, answered only from IRS publications, form instructions, the Internal Revenue Manual and the Internal Revenue Code
audience: people calling a small tax-preparation firm
label: pre-880k

passages.sql: select id, text, title, category, url from (select p.id, p.text, d.title, d.category, p.url, row_number() over (partition by d.category order by md5(p.id || $1)) r from irs_passages p join irs_docs d using (doc) where p.indexed and p.faq is null and length(p.text) between 350 and 1600) x order by r, md5(id || $1) limit $2
passages.countSql: select count(*) filter (where indexed) as indexed_passages, count(*) as fetched_passages from irs_passages
passages.textSql: select id, text from irs_passages where id = any($1)

form.intro: I can fill in the consultation request with you, one question at a time. You press Request consultation yourself at the end.
form.scope: I can only help with this consultation request and questions about the tax guides.
form.doneMessage: I've handed the form back to you. Please check it and press Request consultation yourself.
form.reviewAsk: Is that all right? Say yes and I'll hand the form back for you to send.
